2079-2105-5895-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2079-2105-5895-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2079-2105-5895-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

728-801-2113-3249.easyPrerequisites:
Karametra's Favor attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-801-2113-3249.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Karametra's Favor by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

856-2267-3899-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Tormod trigger.
Resolve the Tormod trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

849-2738-2921-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Anax, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Anax trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

475-1379-3197-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-1379-3197-6824.description:
Gain life in any way.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

549-3197-6830-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-3197-6830-7743.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5003-7702.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Nest Invader, adding {C}{C}.
When Nest Invader dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Nest Invader from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Nest Invader enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

997-3276-5038-7707.description:
When an opponent controls a nontoken creature, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, The Serpent Society triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
When the opposing creature(s) die, Overseer of the Damned triggers that many times, creating that many tapped 2/2 Zombie creature tokens that will have deathtouch due to Archetype of Finality.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat as needed.

648-7652.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on it for each card in your library.
Activate Tom, Bert and William by paying {1} and sacrificing the Fractal, causing you to draw your library and discard a card.

1170-1492-4808-6862.easyPrerequisites: One of the artifacts must be in your hand, while the other is either in your graveyard or in your library.
1170-1492-4808-6862.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1170-1492-4808-6862.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Delivery Moogle.
When Delivery Moogle enters, it triggers, searching your library or graveyard for the other artifact and putting it into your hand.
Activate the artifact cast in step 1 by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

141-997-7446.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-997-7446.description:
Cast Moment of Reckoning by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Moment of Reckoning.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Moment of Reckoning
Resolve the Moment of Reckoning copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-997-7446.notes: You can choose as many modes as allowed with Moment of Reckoning. You must choose the second mode once, but the other three can be as desired.

891-2730-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Repeat.

2099-4559-4802-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
2099-4559-4802-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Master Biomancer.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5315-6972-7159.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Arcbound Tracker.
When Arcbound Tracker dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Tracker's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Tracker from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat.

57-283-1879-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {2}{R}.
57-283-1879-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {2}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

877-4254-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0}.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1669-3293-5721-6763.easyPrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{G}.
You control a Plains.
1669-3293-5721-6763.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{G}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all other Emeria Shepherd triggers, returning any number of nonland permanents from your graveyard to either your hand or the battlefield.
Repeat.
1669-3293-5721-6763.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard to the battlefield if you control two or more Plains. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

2034-4593-4716-6705.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
2034-4593-4716-6705.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

3525-4131-5115-6657.description:
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {3}.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {6} and tapping it, copying Basalt Monolith's ability three times.
Resolve a copy of Basalt Monolith's ability, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 4 two additional times.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Gogo.
Repeat from step 3.

5696-5702-6633.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
5696-5702-6633.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

3918-4038-4131.description:
Activate Trazyn using Basalt Monolith's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

2556-3821-6485.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
2556-3821-6485.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Mnemonic Wall and Peregrine Drake, targeting Mnemonic Wall
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Mnemonic Wall and Peregrine Drake tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

5014-5742-5743-6441.description:
Activate Putrid Imp by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Putrid Imp ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3476-4050-5145-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phantatog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-1418-2733-5478-5954.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to Spelunking.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-2366-2374-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding {C}{C}.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Maja triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Warrior creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1920-2060-3334-4222-5328.notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Attentive Sunscribe.
1920-2060-3334-4222-5328.description:
Activate Freed from the Real's first ability by paying {U}, tapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Attentive Sunscribe triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Arwen Undómiel triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Attentive Sunscribe.
Repeat.

1218-2442-5064.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five untapped Goblins.
1218-2442-5064.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Skirk Fire Marshal +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Activate Auriok Replica by paying {W} and sacrificing it, preventing all damage Skirk Fire Marshal would deal to you this turn.
Activate Skirk Fire Marshal by tapping five Goblins you control, putting ten -1/-1 counters on each other creature and giving each opponent ten poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten poison counters.

97-3197-4017.notablePrerequisites:
Sunbond attached to Herd Baloth.
You have a way to gain life.
97-3197-4017.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Herd Baloth triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on itself.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Ravenous Baloth by sacrificing the Beast token, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2532-3464-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
2532-3464-4050.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Hyrax Tower Scout with haste.
The Hyrax Tower Scout token enters the battlefield, untapping Jaxis.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Hyrax Tower Scout token, adding {R}.
The Hyrax Tower Scout token dies, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1708-2011-3263-4929.notablePrerequisites:
Najeela does not have summoning sickness.
Halana and Alena has at least three power.
Opponents can not block and kill Najeela.
1708-2011-3263-4929.description:
Move to combat.
Halana and Alena trigger, putting at least three +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Attack with at least Najeela.
Najeela triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Najeela by paying {5}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
